_comment: File path prefixes (relative to repo root) exempt from the new-hardcoded-brand check (scripts/check-no-hardcoded-brand.js). The brand config modules legitimately hold the RSV.Pizza defaults; supabase.ts keeps the project-id fallback; i18n holds source strings.
